description: Extends F1a with variable reservoir head model, seawater density correction, and turbine efficiency vs head.

reservoir_height_design_m.description: Design reservoir head above mean sea level

overtopping_rate_design.description: Mean overtopping flow per unit crest width at design wave

eta_turbine_peak.description: Peak turbine efficiency at design head

eta_ramp_design.description: Ramp efficiency at design wave condition

k_head_turbine.description: Turbine efficiency head-dependence curvature: eta(h) = eta_peak*(1-k*(h/h_design-1)^2)

h_min_turbine.description: Minimum reservoir head for turbine operation

overtopping_Hs_exp.description: Power law exponent: Q_overtopping ~ H_s^1.5 (more overtopping at higher waves)

source: Kofoed et al. (2006) Coastal Eng. 53:859-867; Wave Dragon AS (2010); Margheritini et al. (2009) Renew. Energy 34:1473.
